invariants.rationale: It is common for remove methods to require a non-null argument, though the method implementation does not explicitly check for null.
If the actor is already contained in a cell, the cell should reference the actor at method entry.
This captures the exhaustiveness of the 'unfocus' boolean, though not particularly insightful.
It might be undesirable to attempt to unfocus when there is no actor, so this expresses that if actor is null, unfocus should not be true.
